parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster to be added.

parameters.name: DiscoveryOnly
parameters.description: Indicates whether to add the cluster to an ASM instance in only service discovery mode.

parameters.name: IgnoreNamespaceCheck
parameters.description: Specifies whether to check that the cluster you want to add to the ASM instance belongs to the istio-system namespace. This parameter is often used in scenarios where you migrate traffic from self-managed open source Istio to ASM. Valid values: true and false.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh add-cluster-into-service-mesh --service-mesh-id cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --cluster-id ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000 --ignore-namespace-check false --kubeconfig apiVersion:_v1_clusters:_-_cluster:_server:_https://47.110.xx.xx:6443_certificate-authority-data:_ --discovery-only false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh AddClusterIntoServiceMesh --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceMeshId cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --ClusterId ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000 --IgnoreNamespaceCheck false --DiscoveryOnly false --Kubeconfig 'apiVersion:_v1_clusters:_-_cluster:_server:_https://47.110.xx.xx:6443_certificate-authority-data:_'
